text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since Oguri has a scrimmage during her
afternoon class today, I
decide to eat
lunch together with her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next to me is a bag crammed full of bread
and rice balls of all
assortments. How did
she fit that all in one bag?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I got these at the school shop. This should
be enough to get me up
and running.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: One meal.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Well, almost one. I wouldn't be able to run
on a full stomach, so I got
just enough to
keep me energized.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I go to the cafeteria, I end up
eating way too much, so it's
good to get
lunch from the school shop every once in a
while.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap carefully spreads the contents
of her massive bag around
her, chooses
one particularly smushed bread, and
begins to eat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In an instant, all the food she had brought
with her has disappeared.
It's like her
mouth is a black hole that vacuums
anything resembling
food into a void.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That was delicious.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Of course I did.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
There are three rules to eating. Thank the
hands that made the food.
Eat
respectfully. And make sure to chew,
taste, and swallow. That's
what Tome
taught me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The folks back home taught me everything
important. To repay them,
I need to
succeed here at this academy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That reminds me... Tome used to always
give me stuff to munch on.
The homemade
rice balls were to die for.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
They were perfectly round and wrapped in
only the best-tasting nori.
Like a
cannonball, but edible.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Each rice ball would be packed with a
different filling too. Fish, meat,
veggies,
you name it. They had it all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Every bite had just the right mix of rice
and filling, no matter how I
ate it. Eating
those rice balls was pure bliss.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Growl...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Even thinking about them makes my
stomach growl. I guess I
didn't buy enough
to fill me up.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hmmmm... I could go back for some more, but... I don't know if I'd make it back on time...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Really?! If it's okay with you...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I guess one more wouldn't hurt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap's eyes sparkle as I hand her the
rice ball. She downs it
before I can even
blink and looks at me expectantly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before I know it, all three of the rice balls I
brought for lunch have
disappeared into
the void.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thanks so much for the food. You made
these yourself, right?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
They remind me of the rice balls Tome
would give me. They do more
than just fill
my stomach... It's like they warm my very
soul...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Do you have some kind of special
technique?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No special technique, huh? Then there's
gotta be some other secret
to your rice
balls. I'd like to see how you make them if
you don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I've missed the taste of home ever since
coming here. I wanna make
these for
myself, so... would you mind teaching me?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thanks! I really appreciate it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Y'know, being around you reminds me of
back home. It's very
relaxing.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad you're willing to be my trainer.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The nostalgic taste of the rice balls really
hit the spot. I feel fully
recharged, both
mentally and physically. I'm gonna ace
that
scrimmage, just you wait and see!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap keeps to her word and comes in
first place—with an
overwhelming lead
over all the other participants.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While I'm glad she made the most of my
rice balls...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Growl...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I kinda wish she left at least one for me...
